address: Yeniköy, Köybaşı Caddesi No:158 D:B, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34464, Türkiye
bio: With its bright interior and appealing artworks, Lokanta Limu stands out even in this bustling neighbourhood. The decor radiates a sense of serenity, and the closely spaced tables create a convivial atmosphere. Sara Tabrizi and her team of chefs delight in creating generous mezze spreads that bring a fresh perspective to authentic Turkish flavours. Think tuna marinated in raki and served with parsley, apple and red onion, or briefly seared lamb's liver with fried potatoes and onion. The extensive menu features plenty of enticing options that lend themselves well to sharing. To explore a wide range of dishes without breaking the bank, choose the Çilingir Sofrası set menu.
